page.content:
Great magician who restored Osiris and hid Horus.

How Isis connects

  • Character: Osiris — Isis reassembled Osiris and made him king of the dead.
  • Faction: Ennead — Isis is one of the nine of Heliopolis.
  • Character: Horus — Isis conceived and hid the child Horus.

What is Isis?

Isis gathers Osiris' body, conceives Horus, and outwits Set by cunning and names. Her cult later traveled far beyond the Nile.

Key threads lead to Osiris, Ennead and Horus.
